title: Pan-Seared Japanese Mushroom Dumplings
description: A delicious and savory Japanese-inspired dish featuring pillowy and ukrainian-style dumplings filled with earthy mushrooms. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Mushroom (varieties like shiitake or cremini work well)

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add sesame oil, then add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the miso paste, soy sauce, and grated ginger to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the green onions and sesame seeds to the pan and stir to combine.
Pan-fry the Ukrainian dumplings until golden brown on both sides and crispy at the bottom.
Serve the pan-fried dumplings with the mushroom and sauce mixture spooned over the top.
